name: wincraft
description: L3 native egui desktop workstation for WinCraft

tools.name: win_status
tools.description: Host summary: version, read-only state, disk volumes, process count, and PATH health.

tools.name: win_doctor
tools.description: Verify native Restart Manager FFI, Windows admin binaries (sc, reg, wevtutil, robocopy), and Sysinternals cache.

tools.name: win_disk_list
tools.description: List logical disk volumes (A:..Z:) with free/used/total GB via Win32 GetDiskFreeSpaceExW.

tools.name: win_env_audit
tools.description: Audit PATH environment variable for dead/missing directories and duplicate entries.

tools.name: win_proc_list
tools.description: List running Windows processes sorted by memory usage with protected-process classification.

tools.name: win_port_map
tools.description: Map active TCP/UDP ports to owning PIDs and correlate with fleet WEBAPP_PORTS.md assignments.

tools.name: win_weeder_scan
tools.description: Scan for orphaned cargo test binaries, stale headless engines, and runaway workers holding RAM.

tools.name: win_weeder_reap
tools.description: Terminate a non-protected process by PID (requires confirm=true; refuses protected system processes).

tools.name: win_lock_inspect
tools.description: Who locks this file or directory? Queries Windows Restart Manager (rstrtmgr.dll) for locking PIDs.

tools.name: win_fs_list
tools.description: List directory contents with depth control, sizes, and modified timestamps.

tools.name: win_fs_du
tools.description: Fast recursive directory disk usage breakdown + top file extensions.

tools.name: win_fs_large
tools.description: Find largest files exceeding a byte threshold (optionally skipping build dirs).

tools.name: win_fs_dups
tools.description: 3-stage streaming duplicate file detector (size -> 4KB SHA-256 prefix -> full 64KB streaming SHA-256).

tools.name: win_fs_hash
tools.description: Compute streaming FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 digest and byte size of a file.

tools.name: win_fs_grep
tools.description: Search text files for a substring/pattern while skipping binary files and build directories.

tools.name: win_fs_backup_write
tools.description: Write a file safely with mandatory timestamped .bak backup creation if the file exists (confirm=true).

tools.name: win_fs_undo_backup
tools.description: Restore the most recent .bak backup for a file (confirm=true).

tools.name: win_fs_archive_inspect
tools.description: Inspect entries and compression ratios inside a .zip archive.

tools.name: win_fs_archive_create
tools.description: Create a deflated .zip archive from a file or directory (confirm=true).

tools.name: win_svc_list
tools.description: List Windows services with state and PID.

tools.name: win_svc_control
tools.description: Start, stop, or restart a Windows service via sc.exe with NSSM-safe detection (confirm=true).

tools.name: win_startup_list
tools.description: List Windows startup autorun entries across HKCU/HKLM Run keys and Startup folders.

tools.name: win_task_list
tools.description: List Windows Scheduled Tasks via schtasks.

tools.name: win_reg_read
tools.description: Read values and subkeys from a Windows Registry key.

tools.name: win_reg_write
tools.description: Write an HKCU Registry value after exporting a timestamped .reg backup (confirm=true).

tools.name: win_event_tail
tools.description: Query recent critical/error/warning events from a Windows Event Log channel.

tools.name: win_cpu_audit
tools.description: Audit running processes for unauthorized CPU hogs, suspicious volatile paths, and known crypto miner signatures.

tools.name: win_thermal_status
tools.description: Query host CPU load percentage, core topology, clock speeds, and thermal throttle heuristics.
